caption: A cue ball is struck into a tight triangle of balls on a pool table, and the balls scatter across the table in all directions.

sa.check: A tight triangle of balls sits on a pool table.
A cue ball is struck into it.
The balls scatter across the table in all directions.
The strike comes first and the scatter follows.

pc.expect: The balls move only after being struck, spreading outward from the impact.
pc.fail: They move before; or are struck and stay; or scatter from a different point.

pc.expect: The cue ball slows sharply and the struck balls spread outward.
pc.fail: The cue ball keeps its speed; or the balls move as a block; or balls fly back through the cue ball.
Balls overlap; or pass through each other; or sink into the cloth.

pc.expect: Each ball rolls straight and slows.
pc.fail: A ball curves; or speeds up; or restarts.
A ball vanishes; or a new one appears; or balls merge.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The balls' colours and the table stay the same.
pc.fail: Colours swap; or the cloth changes; or the table rearranges.
